speaker: spk_0
text: Morning. Let's start with the retaining wall on the north side.

speaker: spk_1
text: Sure. It rained yesterday, and the drainage channel over there is a bit blocked.

speaker: spk_0
text: Badly blocked? Has any water got through to the foundation?

speaker: spk_1
text: Nothing reached the foundation, just some surface water. A sweep will sort it.

speaker: spk_0
text: Then get Ah Qiang to clear the drainage channel this afternoon.

speaker: spk_1
text: Will do, I'll tell him. Also the guardrail on the third scaffold lift is loose.

speaker: spk_0
text: Loose? Then nobody goes up. Tag it out of service first.

speaker: spk_1
text: Already tagged. The scaffold crew comes Monday to re-inspect.

speaker: spk_0
text: Is the concrete pour still Thursday as planned?

speaker: spk_1
text: Thursday. Forecast says clear, so it should be fine.

speaker: spk_0
text: Has the pump truck been booked?

speaker: spk_0
text: Do it soon. Last time the pump truck wasn't there and we lost half a day.

speaker: spk_1
text: Understood. Also the rebar, we're about thirty metres short for the second floor.

speaker: spk_0
text: Thirty metres isn't much. Have the supplier send it with the rest.
